study type: Cross-sectional study with in vitro experiments
cohort: The study participants included 30 healthy pregnant individuals, 30 patients with mild preeclampsia (MPE), and 30 patients with severe preeclampsia (SPE).
finding: Placental BCYRN1 expression was significantly lower in placentas from patients with mild PE and even lower in severe PE compared to healthy controls, negatively correlating with systolic blood pressure and 24-h urinary protein, with in vitro findings suggesting BCYRN1 upregulation promotes trophoblast viability and prevents apoptosis via the Wnt/beta-catenin pathway.
cross-section timing: Placental tissues were collected after delivery.
